Motorized shade installation and setup

One team to help you choose, measure and install your window treatments.

Consultation & measuring

Tell us about the rooms, the light and privacy you need, and your budget. We’ll help compare suitable products and take the measurements for your quote.

Professional installation

Our team installs your window treatments and checks the fit and operation. You have help from product selection through the final adjustments.

Controls & setup

Questions about motorized shades

Talk through your windows with John and Max. Call (818) 884-5464.

Can I use a remote instead of an app?

Many systems offer a handheld remote or wall control as well as an app. We’ll confirm the options available for your shades. The PowerView® App is required for programmed operation.

Can the shades open and close on a schedule?

Selected systems support scheduled operation. With Hunter Douglas PowerView® Automation, you set schedules in the PowerView® App. We’ll confirm the controls and any gateway needed for your setup.

Will motorized shades work with my smart-home system?

Tell us which system you use. We’ll check the shade motor, controls and any gateway or accessories needed to connect them.

Can you motorize shades I already have?

Sometimes. The product, age, condition and available components determine what’s possible. Send the brand and model if you know them, along with photos, so we can review the options.

How are motorized shades powered?

Power choices depend on the product and may include replaceable batteries, rechargeable power or a wired connection. We’ll discuss access for charging or battery changes. If electrical work is needed, we can discuss the shade requirements with your electrician.

Which areas do you serve?

We’re based in Woodland Hills and serve the San Fernando Valley and parts of greater Los Angeles, including Calabasas, Beverly Hills, Malibu and Santa Monica. Contact us with your ZIP code to discuss your project.
